S3-T41.text: Task T-41 | Payments module | Owner: Aarav | Status: In progress | Last edited: 12 Aug 2026

S1-N04.author: Meera
S1-N04.text: Meeting note N-04 (10 Oct 2026). Decision: hold the v1.0 release until retry behaviour is tested. Nobody has been assigned to write the retry test yet.

S1-README-3.author: Aarav
S1-README-3.text: Payments: registration payments run in test mode. Live keys were never issued, and we stay in test mode until finance approves.

S4-301.author: Aarav
S4-301.text: [Leadership channel, 5 Oct 2026] Sponsor funding for the staging server ends in December. Do not announce this to the wider team yet.

S4-150.author: Aarav
S4-150.text: [18 Sep 2026, #ops] Aarav: The check-in kiosk code lives in /kiosk and nobody has claimed it yet.

S3-T52.author: Meera
S3-T52.text: Task T-52 | Publish v1.0 to the club website | Owner: unassigned | Due: 20 Nov 2026 | Blocked by: T-49 retry test

S3-T58.text: Task T-58 | Announce the portal launch at the club fair | Due: 5 Dec 2026 | Blocked by: T-52

demo-campus_event_portal-8992123f902b.author: Unknown

demo-campus_event_portal-7263401bf04a.author: Unknown
demo-campus_event_portal-7263401bf04a.text: Payments module: Rohan took payments over from Aarav last week, so ping Rohan for registration payment questions. The payments code is in `backend/payments`.

demo-campus_event_portal-f5a8d2e9972a.author: Unknown

demo-campus_event_portal-97d652a1e163.author: Unknown
demo-campus_event_portal-97d652a1e163.text: The payments module has an unfinished retry worker. The release is on hold until retry behaviour is tested. No owner has been assigned to write the retry test.

demo-campus_event_portal-a4ba512c79db.author: Unknown
demo-campus_event_portal-a4ba512c79db.text: A personal account is still used for the payment provider's staging webhook. The project administrator must transfer billing ownership before the handover is complete.

demo-campus_event_portal-ed179731c6b5.text: The check-in kiosk code lives in `/kiosk`. Aarav authored the current kiosk implementation. No successor has accepted ownership.
